issues.desc: CHK-003 bundles two distinct plan milestones (M2 runtime matcher + M3 freshness pack), each with separate deliverables/test sets. In PLAN, ensure verificationIntent covers matcher and freshness pack independently, or consider splitting the item.

Plan M0 covers non-consumption red smokes across session_brief + story intake + DONE closure, but CHK-001 narrows the repro to session_brief only. Consistent with the intentional session-scoped MVP1 tradeoff; confirm the narrowing in PLAN so no M0 exit criterion is silently dropped.

MVP1 done-recognition is not bound to acceptance criteria: the parent plan §7.1 lists six required proofs (active playbook appears; candidate stays inert; pack has source digest; pack remains gateEvidence:false and authority:non_authoritative; 60-line cap works; relevant source mutation detected), but no checklist item enumerates them. CHK-005 only says record verification evidence generically. In PLAN, bind each of the six proofs to a verificationIntent so the user can recognize MVP1 as done.

Operator-observable outcomes are thin outside CHK-004. CHK-001/002/003/005 describe engineering/test deliverables without a concrete operator-visible signal. In PLAN add userSees, especially for CHK-004 (e.g. running lattice session_brief shows a bounded memory/playbook section, <=60 lines, marked non-authoritative / not gate evidence) and for CHK-002 (activate flips a candidate to active while other candidates stay inert).

CHK-003 bundles two distinct plan milestones (M2 runtime matcher + M3 freshness pack), each with separate deliverables/test sets. In PLAN, ensure verificationIntent covers matcher and freshness pack independently, or consider splitting the item.

Plan M0 covers non-consumption red smokes across session_brief + story intake + DONE closure, but CHK-001 narrows the repro to session_brief only. Consistent with the intentional session-scoped MVP1 tradeoff; confirm the narrowing in PLAN so no M0 exit criterion is silently dropped.
